# @mikosoft/dodo — AI Reference (v1.3.0)

Concise reference for AI assistants. Read this file to understand the Dodo framework
without analysing source code. Full docs: http://dodo.mikosoft.info


## What is Dodo

@mikosoft/dodo is a lightweight MVC JavaScript framework for building reactive single-page
applications (SPAs). It has zero external dependencies, requires no build tools or TypeScript,
and uses plain ES6 modules. Supported environments: browsers, browser extensions, Electron,
Cordova/PhoneGap, PWAs.

Key differences from React/Vue/Angular:
- No components — one Controller manages the whole page
- No virtual DOM — updates real DOM via dd-* directive processing
- No JSX/templates — plain HTML files with dd-* attributes
- Reactive model via JavaScript Proxy (not observables or signals)


## Architecture

```
URL change → Router → Controller runs lifecycle hooks → dd-* directives update DOM
```

Two app entry-point classes:

| Class    | File                  | Use case                                  |
|----------|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| App      | core/App.js           | Multi-page SPA with client-side routing   |
| AppOne   | core/AppOne.js        | Single-page, no routing (extensions etc.) |

Supporting classes (inheritance chain, bottom → top):
  Controller → Model → Dd → DdCloners → DdListeners → Auxiliary


## Entry Point Setup

### Multi-page app (App)

```javascript
import { App } from '@mikosoft/dodo';

const app = new App('myApp');
app
  .auth($auth)             // Auth instance → this.$auth in controllers
  .httpClient($httpClient) // HTTP client → this.$httpClient in controllers
  .debug($debugOpts)       // console debug flags
  .fridge($fridge)         // shared object persisting across routes → this.$fridge
  .i18n($i18n)             // translations → used by View.loadI18n(langCode)
  .preflight([fn1, fn2])   // run before every controller __loader()
  .postflight([fn1, fn2])  // run after every controller __postrend()
  .destroyflight(fn)       // run when any controller is destroyed (route change)
  .ssr();                  // dispatches 'ssr-ready' window event after first render

const $routes = [
  ['when',     '/',          HomeCtrl],
  ['when',     '/users/:id', UserCtrl,     { authGuards: ['isLogged'] }],
  ['when',     '/login',     LoginCtrl],
  ['redirect', '/home',      '/'],          // redirect /home → /
  ['do',       [logFn]],                   // run on every route change
  ['notfound', NotfoundCtrl]
];

app.routes($routes).listen();
```

### Single-page app (AppOne)

```javascript
import { AppOne } from '@mikosoft/dodo';
const app = new AppOne('myApp');
app.controller(MyCtrl);
```


## Controller Lifecycle

Every Controller runs hooks in this strict order:

```
__loader(trx) → __init(trx) → __rend(trx) → __postrend(trx)
__destroy() fires when navigating away from the route
```

| Hook           | Purpose                                                       |
|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `__loader(trx)` | Load HTML views/partials into the DOM                        |
| `__init(trx)`  | Set initial values on `$model` and controller properties      |
| `__rend(trx)`  | Call `render()` — processes all dd-* directives               |
| `__postrend(trx)` | Run code after render (fetch data, init 3rd-party plugins) |
| `__destroy()`  | Cleanup (remove event listeners, cancel timers)               |

The `trx` (transitional) object:
```javascript
trx.uri     // '/users/42'
trx.params  // { id: '42' }        — route params from '/users/:id'
trx.query   // { sort: 'asc' }     — query string params
trx.pevent  // popstate/pushstate browser event
```

Minimal controller:
```javascript
import { Controller } from '@mikosoft/dodo';

class HomeCtrl extends Controller {
  async __loader(trx) {
    await this.loadView('#main', '/views/home.html');
  }
  async __init(trx) {
    this.$model.title = 'Hello';
    this.$model.users = [];
  }
  async __rend(trx) {
    await this.render();
  }
  async __postrend(trx) {
    const resp = await this.$httpClient.get('/api/users');
    this.$model.users = resp.data; // triggers reactive render('users') automatically
  }
}
export default HomeCtrl;
```


## Reactive Model ($model)

`this.$model` is a JavaScript Proxy defined on the Controller. Assigning any property
automatically triggers a debounced, serialised `render(modelName)`.

```javascript
this.$model.items = [];        // next tick: render('items') fires
this.$model.count = 42;        // next tick: render('count') fires

// Manual full render (called in __rend):
await this.render();

// Manual targeted render (called anywhere after __init):
await this.render('items');    // only re-renders dd-* elements bound to 'items'
```

Render is debounced per property name (rapid successive assignments = one render) and
serialised globally (renders never run in parallel — prevents listener corruption).

`$modeler` — helper methods auto-defined for each $model property:
```javascript
this.$modeler.items.push(newItem);  // push to array, then render('items')
this.$modeler.items.unshift(item);
this.$modeler.items.set(idx, val);
this.$modeler.items.del(idx);
```


## View System

`this.loadView(cssSelector, htmlFilePath)` — fetches an HTML file and injects it into the
element matching the CSS selector. Called in `__loader()`.

```javascript
async __loader(trx) {
  await this.loadView('#main',     '/views/home.html');
  await this.loadView('#sidebar',  '/views/sidebar.html');
}
```

HTML files are plain HTML fragments (no `<html>/<body>` wrapper needed).

`this.loadI18n(langCode)` — injects translation strings from the `$i18n` object into the
view. Translation keys in HTML: `data-i18n="SOME_KEY"`.


## dd-* Directives Reference

Directives are `dd-*` HTML attributes processed during `render()`. Most take a value
pointing into `$model` or calling a controller method.

### Data Binding

| Directive         | Syntax / Example                                              |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `dd-text`         | `<p dd-text="$model.name"></p>` — set textContent            |
| `dd-html`         | `<div dd-html="$model.richText"></div>` — set innerHTML       |
| `dd-model`        | `<input dd-model="$model.email">` — two-way binding (input ↔ $model), triggers render on input event |
| `dd-value`        | `<input dd-value="$model.count">` — one-way: sets value attr  |
| `dd-set`          | `<input dd-set="$model.search">` — one-way: input → $model on change, no re-render |
| `dd-label`        | `<label dd-label="$model.fieldName"></label>`                 |
| `dd-placeholder`  | `<input dd-placeholder="$model.hint">`                       |
| `dd-title`        | `<span dd-title="$model.tooltip"></span>`                    |
| `dd-data`         | `<div dd-data="id::$model.userId"></div>` — sets data-id attr |

### Conditionals

| Directive    | Example                                          |
|--------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `dd-if`      | `<div dd-if="$model.isAdmin">...</div>` — removes element from DOM if falsy |
| `dd-elseif`  | `<div dd-elseif="$model.isMod">...</div>`        |
| `dd-else`    | `<div dd-else>...</div>`                         |
| `dd-visible` | `<div dd-visible="$model.show">...</div>` — toggles CSS display (element stays in DOM) |

### Loops (Cloner Directives)

| Directive     | Example / Notes                                                    |
|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `dd-each`     | `<li dd-each="users" dd-text="$model.name"></li>` — clones element for each array item |
| `dd-each2`    | Nested loop inside `dd-each` — iterates a sub-array of the parent row |
| `dd-entries`  | `<li dd-entries="settings"></li>` — iterates object key/value pairs; use `$model.key` / `$model.value` inside |
| `dd-repeat`   | `<div dd-repeat="5">★</div>` — clones element N times             |

Inside `dd-each`: `$model` refers to the current array item. `$model.$i` is the 0-based index.

### HTML Attribute Managers

| Directive      | Effect                                           |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `dd-class`     | `<div dd-class="active::$model.isActive">` — add/remove CSS class conditionally |
| `dd-style`     | `<div dd-style="color::$model.color">` — set inline style property |
| `dd-disabled`  | `<button dd-disabled="$model.loading">` — set/remove disabled attr |
| `dd-readonly`  | `<input dd-readonly="$model.locked">`            |
| `dd-required`  | `<input dd-required="$model.mandatory">`         |
| `dd-checked`   | `<input type="checkbox" dd-checked="$model.agreed">` |
| `dd-selected`  | `<option dd-selected="$model.chosen">` — set selected attr |
| `dd-src`       | `<img dd-src="$model.avatarUrl">` — set src attr |
| `dd-attr`      | `<div dd-attr="data-id::$model.id">` — set any attribute |
| `dd-min`       | `<input dd-min="$model.minVal">`                 |
| `dd-max`       | `<input dd-max="$model.maxVal">`                 |

### Event Listeners

| Directive      | Example / Notes                                                         |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `dd-href`      | `<a dd-href="/about">About</a>` — SPA navigation, no page reload        |
| `dd-click`     | `<button dd-click="save()">Save</button>` — calls controller method     |
| `dd-change`    | `<select dd-change="onSelect($event)">` — change event                  |
| `dd-keyup`     | `<input dd-keyup="search()">` or `dd-keyup--13="submit()"` — keyCode filter |
| `dd-enter`     | `<input dd-enter="submit()">` — Enter key shortcut                      |
| `dd-evt`       | `<div dd-evt--mouseover="onHover($event)">` — any DOM event via `--<eventName>` |
| `dd-model`     | See Data Binding — fires on input event                                 |
| `dd-set`       | See Data Binding — fires on change event                                |
| `dd-outclick`  | `<div dd-outclick="close()">` — fires when clicking outside element (dropdowns, modals) |
| `dd-intersect` | `<img dd-intersect="lazyLoad()">` — fires when element enters viewport (IntersectionObserver) |
| `dd-swipe`     | `<div dd-swipe="onSwipe($event)">` or `dd-swipe--left="prev()"` — touch swipe |

### DOM Utilities

| Directive       | Example / Notes                                                    |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `dd-elem`       | `<canvas dd-elem="chart"></canvas>` — exposes element as `this.$elem.chart` in controller |
| `dd-setinitial` | `<input dd-setinitial="$model.lang">` — reads element value into $model on route load |

### Visibility Helpers (`-hide` suffix)

Any directive can use a `-hide` suffix on the **attribute name** to hide the element until
rendering is complete (prevents FOUC):
```html
<ul dd-each-hide="users">...</ul>
```
DoDo injects `[dd-*-hide] { display: none !important; }` via a `<style>` tag at startup.


## Built-in Libraries

Import from corelib:
```javascript
import { corelib } from '@mikosoft/dodo';
const { Auth, HTTPClient, HTTPClientFetch, Form, Cookie,
        BrowserStorage, Paginator, eventEmitter, navig, util, ApiCall } = corelib;
```

### Auth (`core/lib/Auth.js`)
JWT authentication with cookie storage, auto-login on page refresh, and role-based route
guards. Inject into the app with `app.auth($auth)` → available as `this.$auth` in all controllers.

```javascript
await this.$auth.login(credentials);
await this.$auth.logout();
this.$auth.getLoggedUserInfo();       // decoded JWT payload
this.$auth.getJWTtoken();             // raw JWT string
```

Route guard options (passed in route definition):
```javascript
['when', '/dashboard', DashCtrl, { authGuards: ['autoLogin', 'isLogged', 'hasRole'] }]
```

### HTTPClient / HTTPClientFetch (`core/lib/HTTPClient.js`, `HTTPClientFetch.js`)
Two HTTP clients — XMLHttpRequest-based and Fetch API-based. Inject via `app.httpClient($httpClient)`.

```javascript
const resp = await this.$httpClient.get('/api/users', { headers: {...} });
const resp = await this.$httpClient.post('/api/users', body, { headers: {...} });
await this.$httpClient.put('/api/users/1', body);
await this.$httpClient.delete('/api/users/1');
await this.$httpClient.patch('/api/users/1', patch);
```
Features: retry logic, timeouts, request/response interceptors, custom headers.

### ApiCall (`core/lib/ApiCall.js`)
Higher-level abstraction over HTTPClient for structured API calls.

### Form (`core/lib/Form.js`)
Read/write all HTML form control types (text, checkbox, radio, select, file) to/from `$model`.
Handles type conversion and optional validation.

### Cookie (`core/lib/Cookie.js`)
```javascript
Cookie.set('name', value, { expires: 7, secure: true, domain: '.example.com', sameSite: 'Strict' });
Cookie.get('name');
Cookie.delete('name');
```

### BrowserStorage (`core/lib/BrowserStorage.js`)
Simple wrappers around `localStorage` and `sessionStorage`.

### EventEmitter (`core/lib/EventEmitter.js`)
Pub/sub bus for decoupled communication between controllers:
```javascript
eventEmitter.emit('user:loggedIn', userData);
eventEmitter.on('user:loggedIn', handler);
eventEmitter.off('user:loggedIn', handler);
```

### Paginator (`core/lib/Paginator.js`)
Calculates page ranges, total pages, and navigation state for paginated data.

### navig (`core/lib/navig.js`)
```javascript
navig.goto('/dashboard');
navig.goto('/search', { q: 'hello' });   // appends query string
navig.getCurrentURI();                   // '/dashboard?tab=stats'
```

### util (`core/lib/util.js`)
General-purpose helpers: type checking (`util.isObj`, `util.isArr`, ...), deep object clone,
string manipulation, `util.sleep(ms)`.


## Debug Options

`core/conf/$debugOpts.js` defines boolean flags that enable console output per subsystem:

```javascript
const $debugOpts = {
  exeRoute: false,      // router matching
  render: false,        // render() calls
  ddEach: false,        // dd-each processing
  ddClick: false,       // dd-click listener attachment
  // ... one flag per directive and subsystem
};
app.debug($debugOpts);
```

Set any flag to `true` to see detailed console logs for that subsystem.


## Controller Constants (available as `this.*` in every controller)

| Property        | Source             | Description                                   |
|-----------------|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| `this.$model`   | Model.js           | Reactive data proxy                           |
| `this.$modeler` | Model.js           | Array/object mutation helpers                 |
| `this.$dd`      | Dd.js              | Internal directive registry & listener list   |
| `this.$elem`    | Dd.js              | DOM elements captured by `dd-elem`            |
| `this.$fridge`  | App.fridge()       | Shared data across all controllers            |
| `this.$httpClient` | App.httpClient() | HTTP client instance                         |
| `this.$auth`    | App.auth()         | Auth instance                                 |
| `this.$debugOpts` | App.debug()      | Debug flags                                   |
| `this.$appName` | App constructor    | App name string                               |


## Known Issues

### Promise.all() inside `__init()` causes broken rendering

**Status:** Unresolved

Using `Promise.all()`, `Promise.race()`, `Promise.allSettled()`, or `Promise.any()` in
`__init()` can leave orphaned promises. If one branch rejects, `Promise.all` rejects early,
`__init()` returns, `__initFinished = true` is set — but surviving in-flight promises
continue running. When they later resolve and set `$model.x`, they trigger `render('x')`
out of sequence, corrupting the DOM/listener state. No error is thrown.

**Workaround — always use sequential awaits in `__init()`:**
```javascript
// BAD — do not do this:
async __init(trx) {
  await Promise.all([this.loadNetworks(), this.loadUsers()]);
}

// GOOD:
async __init(trx) {
  await this.loadNetworks();
  await this.loadUsers();
}
```

If parallel fetching is needed for performance, move it to `__postrend()` where
`__initFinished` is already `true` and the render queue handles sequencing correctly.


## File Map

```
core/
  index.js              — main export: { App, AppOne, Controller, Model, View, corelib }
  App.js                — multi-page SPA class
  AppOne.js             — single-page app class
  mvc/
    Controller.js       — lifecycle hooks, render(), _doRender()
    Model.js            — $model Proxy, $modeler helpers
    View.js             — loadView(), loadI18n()
    Dd.js               — non-cloner directive processors, $dd/$elem init
    DdCloners.js        — dd-each, dd-each2, dd-entries, dd-repeat
    DdListeners.js      — dd-click, dd-href, dd-model, dd-set, dd-change, dd-keyup,
                          dd-enter, dd-evt, dd-outclick, dd-intersect, dd-swipe
    Auxiliary.js        — _debug(), utility helpers
  misc/
    Router.js           — route matching, trx building, middleware chain
  lib/
    Auth.js
    HTTPClient.js
    HTTPClientFetch.js
    ApiCall.js
    Form.js
    Cookie.js
    BrowserStorage.js
    EventEmitter.js
    Paginator.js
    navig.js
    stringTypeConvert.js
    util.js
    index.js            — exports all lib as `corelib`
  conf/
    $debugOpts.js       — debug flag defaults
```
